thread:
keisha: Hi team, new here. I'm running an embeddings job that streams large files and I'm getting intermittent 429s. Error snippet:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-ratelimit-type: token
retry-after: 20
```
I'm not sure if streaming vs batch is hitting a different quota. Is there a quick way to run this to completion (about 2h) without upgrading to prod keys?

infra-bot: FYI: hosted sandbox keys enforce both QPS and total token quotas. Streaming patterns can exhaust QPS faster even if total tokens are moderate. To request a temporary increase email infra@redwood.com with subject 'sandbox-quick-bump' and include account id, token id if known, expected total tokens, peak qps, duration, and cost center. Typical auto-approve window: <=4M tokens and <=4h.

matt: If you can switch to a batch mode (upload inputs to internal tmp S3 and call embeddings in controlled batches) it smooths QPS and often avoids 429s. Ops can also run a reserved batch from a separate account to avoid touching your sandbox quota.

keisha: I can switch to batching but it's a bit of work. If I request a bump, how fast do infra approvals usually happen?

devx-zoe: Usually within a few hours during business days. If it's urgent, DM me and I can ask infra to expedite. Alternatively, ops can hand you an ephemeral token scoped to embeddings only for 1-2h; DM Raj with the window and cost center.

ops-raj: We need cost center and approx calls/sec. We also prefer sanitized uploads. If you want ops to run it, upload to internal S3 (non-public, lifecycle 7d) and DM me the path. Saturday reserved slot 03:00-05:00 UTC is free this week.

sec-ana: Security note: redact PII before upload. Don't paste tokens in chat. Ephemeral tokens are audited. If unsure about data sensitivity DM me and I'll advise quickly.

keisha: Thanks, I'll try batching first. If that doesn't work I'll request a bump. Cost center (if needed): "search-poc". Estimated total tokens 1.9M, peak ~18 qps, duration ~2h. Appreciate the tips! :pray:
